title: FishBot
description: Automatic fishing mod with realistic behavior and in-game configuration.
body:
🎣 **FishBot** – Automatic Fishing Mod (Client-Side, Fabric)

FishBot is an advanced client-side mod for Minecraft Java (Fabric), designed to fully automate fishing while maintaining realistic behavior and minimizing...

## ⚙️ Features

**Full Automation**
- Automatically casts and reels the fishing rod at the perfect moment.
- Simulates human behavior using configurable random delays.
- Realistic Camera Movement: Subtle idle movement and natural recoil when catching fish.
- Dynamic HUD (MiniHud).

**🖥️ Displays:**
- session time
- fish count
- bot status

**Additional Features:**
- In-Game Configuration (GUI): Fully customizable settings through a clean interface.
- AutoSwitch (Auto Rod Selection): Automatically selects the fishing rod when enabled.
- Multilingual Support: Automatically matches the game language (PL / EN).

## ▶️ How to Use

**1. Set Keybinds**
- Options → Controls → AutoFishing
- Toggle Bot (default: F)
- Open Menu (default: R)

**2. Adjust HUD**
- Open menu (R)
- Click “MiniGui Position”
- Drag it anywhere
- Scroll to resize

**3. Start Fishing**
- Have a fishing rod
- Stand near water
- Press F

The bot will start automatically. You can leave your PC and relax ☕

## 🔧 Advanced Settings

**Cast Delay**
- Delay before recasting
- recommended: 800 – 2200 ms

**Reel Delay**
- Reaction time after a bite
- recommended: 100 – 350 ms
- ~200 ms = human-like reaction

**🎥 Camera Animation**
- 1.0 → natural
- lower → smoother
- higher → stronger movement

**⚠️ Please note:** This mod is intended for singleplayer or servers that allow automation mods. Usage on public servers may violate their rules!
